templates.name: Start the session
templates.description: Recap, weather and the opening scene.

spec.prompt: Start session for {{party}}: post a three-line recap of last session to the table chat, roll today's weather for {{place}}, and propose an opening scene.

templates.name: End the session
templates.description: Wrap up: XP, loot and notes.

spec.prompt: End the session: list what the party did, propose XP or a milestone, list loot to hand out, and write DM notes on open threads.

templates.name: Long rest
templates.description: Run a long rest the house-rule way.

spec.prompt: The party takes a long rest at {{place}}. Advance the clock, run house-rule rest effects, and propose a night encounter only if the place is dangerous.

templates.name: Shop visit
templates.description: Open a shop for the party.

spec.prompt: The party visits a {{type}} in {{place}}. Make or open the shop, with a keeper and today's stock.

templates.name: Travel day
templates.description: A day of travel with a check and an event.

spec.prompt: The party travels from {{from}} to {{to}}. Advance the clock by a day, roll a navigation check, and propose one event on the road.
Make a quick NPC for {{role}} in {{place}}: name, look, voice and a want, and add them to the library.
The party searches {{room}}. Propose fitting loot for level {{level}}, with one clue to the next lead.

templates.name: Downtime day
templates.description: Open the downtime prompt for everyone.

spec.prompt: A day of downtime passes. Open the house rule downtime prompt for every player, and list what each is working on.
